question: Who among the following writers has written the famous Hindi novel ‘Godan’?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Munshi Premchand.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Munshi Premchand** has written the famous Hindi Novel **"Godan".**
 
• It was first published in 1936 and is considered one of the greatest Hindi novels of modern Indian literature.
 
• **Premchand** was a pioneer of **Hindi and Urdu **social fiction.
 
• It highlights the struggle between the peasant and the money-lender backed by various forces.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Gillu is written by the famous writer **Mahadevi Verma**. It is a touching story of a squirrel named Gillu.
 
• Kamayani is a Hindi epic poem by **Jaishankar Prasad**. It is considered one of the greatest literary works written in modern times in Hindi literature.
 
• Amrita Pritam is one of the best known Punjabi authors and poets. 
 
• She wrote fiction, non-fiction, poetry and essays. She has over 100 works to her name and had been honored with some of the highest awards in the country including the Sahitya Akademi, Bharatiya Jnanpith, and Padma Vibhushan.
